#!/bin/sh
set -e
CERTDIR=/etc/nginx/certs
DAYS=30
THRESHOLD_SECS=864000
NODE_IP_VAL="10.100.28.10"
NODE_NAME_VAL="node1"
FORCE="${1:-}"

NEED_RENEW=0
if [ ! -f "$CERTDIR/cert.pem" ]; then
  NEED_RENEW=1
elif [ "$FORCE" = "--force" ]; then
  NEED_RENEW=1
elif ! openssl x509 -checkend "$THRESHOLD_SECS" -noout -in "$CERTDIR/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NEED_RENEW=1
fi

if [ "$NEED_RENEW" = "1" ]; then
  TMPKEY=$(mktemp)
  TMPCRT=$(mktemp)
  openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout "$TMPKEY" -out "$TMPCRT" \
    -days "$DAYS" -nodes -subj "/CN=$NODE_NAME_VAL" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=IP:$NODE_IP_VAL" >/tmp/renew_openssl.log 2>&1
  mv "$TMPKEY" "$CERTDIR/key.pem"
  mv "$TMPCRT" "$CERTDIR/cert.pem"
  chmod 600 "$CERTDIR/key.pem"
  chmod 644 "$CERTDIR/cert.pem"
  rc-service nginx status >/dev/null 2>&1 && rc-service nginx reload
  SERIAL=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERTDIR/cert.pem" -noout -serial)
  echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) renewed cert serial=$SERIAL" >> /var/log/cert-renew.log
fi

exit=0
